title: Nigel Farage wins Clacton byelection in contest boycotted by other main parties

paragraphs.en: Nigel Farage has seen off Count Binface to win the Clacton byelection in a contest boycotted by every other major political party.
paragraphs.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇击败伯爵·宾费斯，赢下了克拉克顿补选，这场竞选遭到其他所有主要政党的抵制。

paragraphs.en: The Reform UK leader in July triggered the byelection in an attempt to shake off a deepening scandal over a £5m gift he received from the cryptocurrency billionaire Christopher Harborne.
paragraphs.zh: 7月，这位英国改革党领袖发起补选，试图摆脱因接受加密货币亿万富翁克里斯托弗·哈伯恩500万英镑馈赠而日益加深的丑闻。

paragraphs.en: After a campaign in which a record-breaking 34 candidates vied for the coastal seat, Farage held on to Clacton, with 22,239 votes (63.34%). Farage increased his general election vote by just over 1,000 ballots, despite a lower turnout but without any competition from the major parties.
paragraphs.zh: 在创纪录的34名候选人角逐这一海滨席位的竞选之后，法拉奇保住了克拉克顿，获得22,239票（63.34%）。尽管投票率较低，且没有主要政党的竞争，法拉奇的得票数仍比大选时增加了1,000余票。

paragraphs.en: His nearest competitor, Count Binface, a parody candidate dressed as an intergalactic rubbish bin, won 9,455 votes (26.93%). The turnout was 44%. The result was not as seismic for Farage as some polls had predicted.
paragraphs.zh: 他最接近的竞争对手伯爵·宾费斯——一名打扮成星际垃圾桶的恶搞候选人——获得9,455票（26.93%）。投票率为44%。这一结果对法拉奇而言，并不像一些民调预测的那样具有震撼性。

paragraphs.en: A poll from Survation on Monday put Farage on 75% of the vote, with Binface on 20%. Farage declared himself the winner while the votes were still being counted.
paragraphs.zh: Survation周一公布的一项民调显示，法拉奇的支持率为75%，宾费斯为20%。在计票仍在进行时，法拉奇就宣布自己获胜。

paragraphs.en: Despite winning, Farage did not appear at the count for a victory lap, and claimed that Essex police had advised him that a plot was under way to embarrass him when the result was declared. The Guardian understands that the force did not advise Farage not to attend. Lee Anderson said he had not spoken with Farage about his claim, with conflicting accounts emerging. The Reform MP for Ashfield told BBC Breakfast: “Sometimes some of these police forces that we’ve been dealing with recently are about as honest as you lot at the BBC.”
paragraphs.zh: 尽管获胜，法拉奇并未现身计票现场进行胜利巡礼，并声称埃塞克斯警方曾告知他，有人正密谋在结果公布时让他难堪。《卫报》了解到，该警局并未建议法拉奇不要出席。李·安德森表示，他未就这一说法与法拉奇交谈过，各方说法相互矛盾。这位阿什菲尔德选区的改革党议员对BBC《早餐》节目说：“有时候，我们最近打交道的这些警察部队，其诚实程度和你们BBC这些人差不多。”

paragraphs.en: On the night, the contest was resolutely low energy, with hardly any Reform supporters in the room. When Farage was announced as the winner, his supporters were nowhere to be seen or heard in the counting hall. The result came after a gruelling count in which tellers had to grapple with a 90cm-long ballot paper – the longest in British political history – to tally tens of thousands of votes past sunrise.
paragraphs.zh: 当晚的竞选气氛确实低迷，现场几乎没有改革党的支持者。当法拉奇被宣布获胜时，计票大厅里看不到也听不到他支持者的身影和声音。这一结果是在一场艰苦的计票之后得出的，计票员不得不处理一张90厘米长的选票——英国政治史上最长的选票——从日出前一直清点到日出之后，清点了数万张选票。

paragraphs.en: Aside from Farage, who snubbed the count, the remaining 33 candidates lined up – nearly filling the width of the room – when the results were announced. The announcement of Count Binface’s 9,000-plus votes was greeted with moderate cheers and claps in the hall.
paragraphs.zh: 除了没有出席计票现场的法拉奇之外，其余33名候选人在结果公布时站成一排——几乎横跨了整个房间的宽度。当宣布伯爵·宾费斯获得9,000多张选票时，大厅里响起了适度的欢呼和掌声。
